verdict.rationale: Gecko runs its own PR scans and posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab. A configurable fail-on severity threshold fails that check, and findings introduced by the PR are separated from pre-existing ones. This is a hosted status check, not a scanner you run inside your CI pipeline that returns exit codes. missing for 10: a CLI or CI step that returns non-zero exit codes, explicit confirmation that only new findings trip the failure, and independent hands-on corroboration of PR gating.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: Gecko posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab so reviewers see the security status inline.
**Fail-on severity**: the severity threshold that fails the check (for example, fail on High and above).
Findings introduced by the PR are separated from pre-existing ones, so reviewers focus on what the change adds.
